verdict.rationale: Parahelp documents an API: requests can come in through it, and the Internal Agent can be run via it. So an API reference is a fair axis for this product. However, nothing in the evidence describes an interactive API reference or runnable examples, and the probe for an OpenAPI spec returned 404 on every candidate path.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
